title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable Agent Studio demo built from the existing pinned ADR-0056 seed. It specifies two mock projects with Wiki and all board lanes, a six-state Dossier lifecycle gallery, a real Task Server, a replay-only Runner, a startup-locked server execution denial, a read-only visitor surface, scrub proof, dedicated-VM isolation, deterministic reset and seed versioning, and a six-slice launch plan plus an optional later per-session sandbox.
